title: Discover detection capabilities on every reported camera stream
problem: Multi-lens cameras outside a two-model allowlist discard channel-1 motion and AI events even when that lens advertises and sends those detections.
reproduce: Give a camera one primary channel and a second stream whose Baichuan abilities advertise motion plus people, vehicle and dog/cat detection; the pinned baseline creates no channel-1 detection capabilities or state entries.
acceptance: The second stream receives only its explicitly advertised motion and AI capabilities, incoming channel-1 events update those states, and an extra stream without detection bits remains unadvertised.
repair: Discover basic motion and object detection for every reported stream channel, retain the legacy missing-motion fallback only for real camera channels, and replace the model gate with reported detection evidence while keeping the old allowlist as a compatibility fallback.

selection.reason: A less-than-one-day-old report gives an exact regression window, raw ability/event data and two affected models; the owner is waiting with a live camera and explicitly offers immediate branch validation.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the real Baichuan ability parser, combined capability construction and channel-1 event parser against the reporter's advertised bit pattern. It also verifies that an unadvertised stream gains no false detection capability. The physical OMVI 3i PoE and RLC-81MA remain owner-validated.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the branch on Home Assistant with the OMVI 3i PoE or RLC-81MA, restart the integration, confirm motion/person/vehicle/animal entities exist for lens 2, then trigger each detection and verify only the matching entity changes without unknown-event warnings.
